questions.label: 第一次买：能亲自查看或试用有多重要？
questions.original: In general, when shopping for something that you haven’t purchased before, how important is it for you to be able to look at or try out the product in person?

questions.label: 第一次买：能看网上评价有多重要？
questions.original: In general, when shopping for something that you haven’t purchased before, how important is it for you to be able to read ratings or reviews that other people have posted online?

questions.label: 第一次买：能直接网购有多重要？
questions.original: In general, when shopping for something that you haven’t purchased before, how important is it for you to be able to buy online, without having to make a trip to the store?

questions.label: 第一次买：能比较多家价格有多重要？
questions.original: In general, when shopping for something that you haven’t purchased before, how important is it for you to be able to compare prices from a number of different sellers?

questions.label: 第一次买：能询问商品情况有多重要？
questions.original: In general, when shopping for something that you haven’t purchased before, how important is it for you to be able to be able to ask questions about what it is that you’re buying?

questions.label: 第一次买：熟人建议有多重要？
questions.original: In general, when shopping for something that you haven’t purchased before, how important is it for you to be able to get advice or recommendations from people you know?

questions.label: 第一次买：熟悉卖家有多重要？
questions.original: In general, when shopping for something that you haven’t purchased before, how important is it for you to be able to buy from a store or seller that you are familiar with?

questions.label: 网上评价对保证商品安全有多大帮助？
questions.original: Consumers today can access lots of customer reviews and ratings about products and services they might want to buy. How much do you think these ratings and reviews help to ensure that the products and services people buy are safe?

questions.label: 网上评价对增强购买信心有多大帮助？
questions.original: Consumers today can access lots of customer reviews and ratings about products and services they might want to buy. How much do you think these ratings and reviews help to make consumers feel confident about what they are buying?

questions.label: 网上评价对促使商家负责有多大帮助？
questions.original: Consumers today can access lots of customer reviews and ratings about products and services they might want to buy. How much do you think these ratings and reviews help to make companies be accountable to their customers?

questions.label: 第一次买某件商品时，多常阅读网上评价？
questions.original: How often do you read customer ratings or reviews that other people have posted online when buying something for the first time?

questions.label: 在实体店里，会用手机查网上更低价格吗？
questions.original: Do you ever use a cell phone while you are inside a physical store to see if you can find a better price online for something you want to buy?

questions.label: 在实体店里，会用手机查商品评价等信息吗？
questions.original: Do you ever use a cell phone while you are inside a physical store to look up reviews or other information online about a product you want to buy?
